title: armeria maritima var. caespitosa
intro: Armeria maritima var. caespitosa, commonly known as Sea Thrift, is a low-growing, evergreen perennial plant with dense clusters of pink or white flowers that bloom from late spring to early summer. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its potential health benefits. Armeria maritima var. caespitosa is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional uses. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
